<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
**1** anchor(s) derived from **2** changed package(s); no hand-written page names any of them, so this run has **nothing to list** — **not a clean bill of health**. This check sees only pages that NAME a derived anchor: one that documents this change in prose, or enumerates it in an authoring dialect, names none and stays invisible to it on every run.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **2** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **67** of **249** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **174** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 3f7fdd002130a34ce24f735733c2642538914af9` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `b5cd3a0bd1ac6dad896ab6813122bb124de67c24` — the merge of head `75244b315e1d79c1455fbd2d343e00be5fbcbf8b` into base `3f7fdd002130a34ce24f735733c2642538914af9`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin b5cd3a0bd1ac6dad896ab6813122bb124de67c24 && git checkout b5cd3a0bd1ac6dad896ab6813122bb124de67c24
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 3f7fdd002130a34ce24f735733c2642538914af9 75244b315e1d79c1455fbd2d343e00be5fbcbf8b && git checkout -B drift-repro 3f7fdd002130a34ce24f735733c2642538914af9 && git merge --no-ff 75244b315e1d79c1455fbd2d343e00be5fbcbf8b

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 3f7fdd002130a34ce24f735733c2642538914af9
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:默认列表工具栏里,看板、日历这类视图如果除了刷新以外没有别的显示选项,就不再出现一个点开只有底栏的空「显示」入口;宽工具栏(`compactToolbar: false`)的刷新按钮不变。
- 为什么做:卡 #36002,两行工具栏按「刷新去掉」落地后剩下的收尾。
- 出错会怎样:最坏是这类视图少了「显示」入口,而它本来就没有可用选项;spec 只改描述文字,键、类型、默认值都不变。可整体撤回。
- 要你做什么:无。
- 席位意见:ACCEPT。在席位的 spec 描述面 L2(契约档)PASS 之后,作为非受管 PR 落地。

## 席位核对

- 形态:`l1-face --pr 36339` CLEAN(13 项无标记);draft、base `main`、`Fixes #36002`,两条验收都交付,`Fixes` 正确;8 个文件 +104 −12;`check-governed-merges` NOT governed,116 行。文件面比首次认领多出 `view.form.ts` 和生成的 `en.metadata-forms.generated.ts`,两者都是被 hint == describe 的钉逼出来的,修订认领 7076109594 已把它们写进去。
- 前提实测:在本 head 上,`ListView.tsx` 里 `toolbarFlags.showRefresh` 只剩一处读取(`:7785`,`showRefresh && !compactToolbar`,即宽工具栏的按钮),所以「默认工具栏既没有刷新按钮,面板里也没有」属实,新的描述「只管宽工具栏的刷新」也属实。卡的第 2 项(ADR-0049)走第一条分支:只补 spec 说明、不移除这个键,与认领一致。
- 逐句核:changeset 两段;`content/docs/references/ui/{view,page}.mdx` 四行是 `check:generated` 生成的,与 `view.zod.ts` 的 describe 逐字相同;`view.form.ts` 的 hint 和生成的英文 bundle 与 describe 逐字相同。
- 测试证据:新钉 `ListView.refreshOnlyDisplay-36002`,一条阳性加两条对照(宽工具栏仍画刷新;打开行高后仍画显示入口);消融把 `|| toolbarFlags.showRefresh` 放回去后,阳性那条变红,两条对照仍绿,恢复后 blob 等于 HEAD。本地在本 head 上跑了 spec 869 个文件、platform-objects 125 个、harness 127 条测试,全过。
- 门禁 check-runs @ `75244b31`:63 success · 11 expected skip · 0 failed · 0 pending;Lint & Repo Gates、TypeScript Type Check 均 success。
- 接受的偏差:另外十个语言的 hint 译文仍只有第一句,仍然属实,只是没有英文精确;要补齐得由译者来改,不在本卡内。`compactToolbar` 的 describe 没写它是渲染器默认值,dev 记为观察,未立卡,这里照收。
- 范围外去向:无。
- 落地条款:非受管。席位的契约档 L2(claim 7076117439)PASS 在案、无未闭 must-fix/should-fix ⇒ ready + auto-merge。

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `75244b315e1d79c1455fbd2d343e00be5fbcbf8b`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/ui/view.form.ts + ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx

Read for this record: card #36002 (body and all seven comments: triage, both claims and the amended claim, both dev reports, the handover), PR #36339 (body, 8-file list, net diff against merge-base `c30ce97c`), and the 70 check-runs on the head (each `success` or `skipped`, none failed, none pending). The rest of the diff (the harness test block, the changeset, the regenerated `content/docs/references/ui/{view,page}.mdx` and `en.metadata-forms.generated.ts`) is the lane seat's ACCEPT at `TIER_DEFAULT`.

### ① Derived judgments

- Accept set: unchanged, right. `UserActionsConfigSchema.refresh` stays `z.boolean().default(true)` inside the same `strictObject`; only the `.describe()` string moved. No key, type, default or tombstone changes, so nothing parses differently at any door. `Spec property liveness` and `Type Check · consumer gates` are green on the head.
- Public surface, spec text: the describe of `userActions.refresh` and the view form's hint for it change, and through them the generated reference tables and the English metadata-forms help text. Right: text only, and the hint equals the describe (the pin `view-form-composite-children.test.ts` requires it; `Test Core` 10/10 green).
- Public surface, renderer: in the default toolbar, `displayOffered` no longer counts `toolbarFlags.showRefresh`. A non-grid view with no layout switch, Group, Row colour, Row height, Hide fields or Export draws no Display entry, and its phone `openViewSettings` door is absent with it. Right against the card's first acceptance line. The wide toolbar is untouched: `toolbarFlags.showRefresh && !toolbarFlags.compactToolbar` at `ListView.tsx:7785` still draws `refresh-button`.
- Liveness: the key keeps a live reader (`ListView.tsx:2646` into `:7785`), so the ledger row for `userActions` stays `live`. Right that it does not move.

### ② Semver level

The changeset names `@object-ui/plugin-list`, `@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/platform-objects`, each `patch`. That matches what the diff publishes: a renderer fix that removes an entry which offered no display option, a description-only spec edit, and a regenerated English help string. `Check Changeset` is green.

`Clause-②: no` on the PR body and on the changeset, agreeing with both claims. Right: no accepted value is refused, no declared capability is taken away at the consumer. The one thing a reader could reach before and cannot now is named under ④ N1, and it keeps other doors.

`Metadata-protocol: none` is right: no stored metadata shape changes.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev flag, file surface beyond the first claim (`view.form.ts`, `en.metadata-forms.generated.ts`): answered. Forced by the hint == describe pin, and the amended claim on the card (seat 7, 07:46Z) carries both files.
- Dev flag, test placed in the shared `ListView.harness.test.tsx`: answered, the lane seat's call under its harness rule; outside this record's scope.
- Dev flag, final-head union not run by seat 4: answered by the resuming thread's report and, for this record, by the green check-runs on the head.
- Dev flag, branch behind `origin/main`: answered for this head only. `ListView.tsx` has moved on `main` since the merge-base; the premise still holds there (`showRefresh` is still read three times on `origin/main`). A merge of `main` moves the head, and this record does not cover the new one.
- `open_questions`: empty in both reports. Nothing to escalate.
- Card item 2 (ADR-0049, what the key means in the default toolbar): answered by the card's own first branch. The maintainer's 「刷新去掉」 leaves the key with no meaning in the default toolbar; that is a spec note on the key, which this PR writes. No retirement is proposed, so no further card is owed by this PR.
- SQL push-down: no query, id materialisation or in-app join is added or changed. Nothing to flag.

### ④ Design judgment

`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` — holds. The new describe makes three claims, each read in the head's tree:
1. "Governs only the wide toolbar's Refresh button (`compactToolbar: false`)": the only reader of the key in `ui/` and `packages/` is `showRefresh: ua?.refresh !== false` (`ListView.tsx:2646`), and after this PR its only use is the bar button gated on `!toolbarFlags.compactToolbar` (`:7785`).
2. "the default toolbar has no Refresh": `compactToolbar: schema.compactToolbar !== false` (`:2654`) makes the Display form the default, and `ViewSettingsPopover` is handed no refresh prop and draws none.
3. "so the toggle changes nothing there": true only with this PR's `displayOffered` hunk, which is in the same diff. Pull-to-refresh (`:3617`) is enabled on `dataSource` and `objectName` alone and never read the key, so the sentence holds for it as well.
Tried to break it: looked for a second reader under another spelling (`showRefresh`, `userActions.refresh`, `.refresh !== false`) in the grid, kanban, calendar, gantt, mobile and app-shell packages; found none.

`packages/spec/src/ui/view.form.ts` — holds. The hint is the describe, character for character, as the pin requires.

`ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` (implementing) — agrees with the contract. The `displayOffered` hunk removes exactly the one term; the remaining terms each name a control the panel actually draws. Both rewritten comments are true of the tree, with the one imprecision in N1. The pin in the harness file reads the source and covers the fix plus two controls.

No must-fix, no should-fix.

Nits:
- N1 (nit) — the `displayOffered` comment's premise, the test's jsdoc and the changeset say the lost panel held "only its footer". In a host that shows views (`onPersonalizationChange` or `onRenameView`, and a label) the panel also headed with the view's name row, the in-place rename of objectstack#35551, and its footer carried Save and Restore defaults. None of these is lost as a capability: Save and Discard stay on the condition row (`ListDraftActions`), rename stays in the view switcher (`ObjectView.tsx:1165`) and in Manage views (`:1548`). Wording only; left as an accepted deviation, since a fix in `ListView.tsx` moves the head.
- N2 (nit) — the describe leans on "the default toolbar" being the Display form, which the spec does not state: `compactToolbar` is `z.boolean().optional()` and its describe names neither the renderer default nor that Refresh is dropped. The dev reported this as noted, not filed. A follow-up card, not this PR.
- N3 (nit) — `packages/spec/liveness/view.json`, the `userActions` note still reads "drives the manual toolbar Refresh button" without the wide-toolbar scope. Still true, less precise than the describe; same follow-up as N2.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-36002-refresh-display-panel`
Reviewed-by: `session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC`

**VERDICT: PASS**
